summary:
Every acceptance criterion holds on everything this PC could reach without a whole-drive scan.

Code-level results:
- The whole suite passed, 1204 of 1204.
- Fitness passed: all 105 rules hold, including the three SL-001 rules.
- The written-once script held all its checks.

The published exe was run in report mode through SL-001-CoveragePanel.Tests.ps1 -Publish, and all of cases A to H held:
- A: a SUBST letter over a %TEMP% tree on C:. The measured $MFT is 10,540,285,952, equal to FileInfo of C:\$MFT. Measured + remainder = unseen, and the finished line is word for word.
- E: run on this PC's real container layer store. The store is named as 'not-scanned' with no size, includesStore is true, and opensUnderExcludedStore is 0.
- H: a stopped scan shows no panel, and the partial line is word for word.

Real-redirector checks on the mapped Z:\ (\\100.109.48.75\collab):
- A finished scan of a SUBST letter over one Z:\ subfolder: completed, with no volume line, coverage null and the panel hidden. It was larger than intended: 15,548 files, 1,823 folders, 28 s, read-only.
- A scan of Z:\ itself, stopped by the hook at 15 folders: no partial volume line, where a local stopped scan shows one. Its live counters read '1 folder unreadable', in the singular.

The report stays schema 1, with 'coverage' and window 'CoveragePanel' added and OutcomeTexts 'verticalOffset' added.

Not reached:
- The panel on the real whole C:\ (spike clauses b and c): it needs the person's allow for a whole-drive scan.
- A finished scan of Z:\ itself.
- DFS letters and non-NTFS volumes: none on this PC.
- The person's network pass, which is stale.

The panel starts 113 px into a texts region that shows 76 px, so on every finished ending it is a scroll away. This is the design's accepted placement. Nobody has yet looked at a picture of it: the engine's one screen labelled as the ending is in fact the drive picker.

No 'What this slice owes' block was given; the design's 14 items are graded as the criteria.

checks.command: pwsh -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File eng/dotnet.ps1 test FsAnalyser.slnx  (TAAD3_HOME = new empty scratch folder)
checks.evidence: Passed! - Failed: 0, Passed: 1204, Skipped: 0, Total: 1204, Duration: 53 s; exit 0. Z:\ was reachable, so EveryMappedNetworkDriveOnThisPcIsRemoteAndGetsNoFigure ran its remote half and passed.

checks.what: SL-001 window cases A-H on a freshly published exe
checks.evidence:
ALL CHECKS HELD, exit 0, 33 s.
- A: completed. seenOnDisk = core.bytesOnDisk 3,932,160; unseen 876,377,513,984 = measured + remainder. $MFT 10,540,285,952 = FileInfo C:\$MFT. includesStore False. OutcomeDetail is 4 lines, with the finished line word for word. Panel top 113.08 px vs OutcomeTexts 76 px (a scroll away).
- B: folder root gives coverage null, panel hidden.
- C: free letter gives root-unreadable, coverage null.
- D: 2 'unreadable' folders with null size, equal to core.unreadable. Remainder 'It includes 2 folders this scan could not read.'
- E: real store gives includesStore True. Remainder '...It includes the Windows container layer store, which this scan left out unopened.'
- F/G: sizeNotRead kept apart. Singular note '1 file could not be opened to read its true size on disk; its listed size was used.'
- H: cancelled, coverage null, top null, partial line word for word.

105 rules checked against 192 parsed files: every declared rule holds, including 'in the App, only UnreadableRows words the container layer store'. One rule matches no files ('the committed whole-C:\ record...', .taad/slices/SL-089/c-drive-run.json). That record was removed at 21632dc, before this slice, so it is not this slice's.

checks.what: Written-once fitness rules: fire/quiet rows and the real App tree
checks.evidence: ALL CHECKS HELD, exit 0: 16 App sources read, no store word outside UnreadableRows, no fixed-plural count, and WindowReport reads neither CoverageLines nor ScreenLines.

checks.what: SC-015 on the real SMB redirector: finished whole-drive-shaped root over a network path (SUBST letter over one Z:\ subfolder)
checks.command: subst Y: <Z:\ top-level folder #0>; pwsh -File eng/read-window.ps1 -Root Y:\ -Exe artifacts/publish/FsAnalyser.App.exe -TimeoutSec 180 -Outcome; subst Y: /D
checks.evidence: EXIT 0, outcome completed: 15,548 files, 1,823 folders, 434.4 MB on disk, read in 28.3 s. OutcomeDetail has 3 lines and no 'The volume reports' line. coverage null. CoveragePanel {visible:false, actualHeight:0, top:null}. schema 1. The SUBST was removed (exit 0). The sample was bigger than the bounded few thousand files intended (all three Z:\ top-level folders had 400+ entries). It was a read-only metadata scan.

checks.what: SC-015 on the mapped Z:\ itself, stopped early by the hook (a local stopped whole-drive scan shows the partial volume line; a remote one must not)
checks.evidence: EXIT 0, outcome cancelled after 49 files and 49 folders. OutcomeDetail has no volume line. coverage null, panel hidden. CountersText '47 files, 32 folders, 187.9 KB (276.0 KB on disk), 1 folder unreadable': the live counters are singular on a real share (SC-044). No FsAnalyser.App process was left running.

checks.what: Panel model guard and wording read against the criteria (O-015)
checks.command: Read src/FsAnalyser.App/CoveragePanelText.cs; git diff 21632dc HEAD -- MainWindow.xaml(.cs), WindowReport.cs, UnreadableRows.cs, VolumeSpace.cs, FigureText.cs, FolderTreeNode.cs, TopLevelRowText.cs
checks.evidence:
- Build returns null when the scan did not finish or unseen < 0 (CoveragePanelText.cs:81).
- The $MFT is a measured part only when it is above 0 and no more than unseen (:85). The remainder is unseen minus measured (:90) and is worded 'Space this account cannot read ... it is not measured'.
- Store wording comes from UnreadableRows.NotScannedInRemainder.
- AddVolumeInUse calls ShowCoverage only when the figure is a number. ShowOutcome and ShowProblem call HideCoverage.
- VolumeSpace.Read gives a remote root null. ReadMft runs only after a used figure.
- UnreadableRows has a named ContainerLayerStore arm plus a neutral fallback in each of its five functions.
- The XAML UnreadableTab comment and the WindowReport UnreadableExpander remark now say the tab includes the left-out store.

checks.what: Report stays schema 1 with additive keys
checks.evidence: schema: 1. Top-level keys are schema, root, window, largestFilesShown, largestFileOnDisk, largestFilesMs, core, outcome, refusal, workarounds, coverage, kinds. Window keys include OutcomeTexts (with verticalOffset), CoveragePanel and UnreadableExpander, which is still present.

checks.what: Panel on the real whole C:\ (spike clauses a/b/c: finished-arm line, unseen >= $MFT, number of unreadable folders vs the cap of 20)
checks.command: one non-elevated report-mode scan of C:\ with this build
checks.evidence: A whole-drive scan needs the person's allow first. This answer has no allow field, so it is left to the person (build's person-run item).

checks.what: DFS letter and non-NTFS volume shapes
checks.evidence: This PC has no DFS letter and no non-NTFS volume (drives: C:\ Fixed NTFS, D:\ Fixed NTFS, Z:\ Network). These shapes are covered only by unit tests: VolumeUsageTests ARemoteRootGetsNoFigure and the null $MFT reader cases, which passed in the suite.

checks.what: Network pass N-001..N-004 plus StalledShareTests (stale: this slice touched MainWindow.xaml(.cs), Scanning/** and the hook)
checks.evidence: It changes the machine's SMB mappings, so it is person-run by the project's constraints.

criteria.criterion: 1 Show the coverage panel and put it in the report: a finished scan of a whole local drive (SUBST over a %TEMP% tree) whose volume figure lands, unseen >= 0
criteria.how: Case A on the published exe: completed, coverage present, CoveragePanel visible under OutcomeDetail, measured + remainder = unseen = 876,377,513,984, finished line word for word. Not seen on a real whole C:\ (not_reached).

criteria.criterion: 2 Show no coverage panel: a folder root
criteria.how: Case B: coverage null, CoveragePanel not visible, top null, no volume line.

criteria.criterion: 3 Show no coverage panel: a drive-letter root that could not be read
criteria.how: Case C: root-unreadable, coverage null, panel not visible.

criteria.criterion: 4 Show no coverage panel and keep the partial line word for word: a whole-drive scan stopped mid-scan whose volume figure still lands
criteria.how: Case H (hook stop at 15 folders): cancelled, coverage null, top null. The partial line is word for word: 'The volume reports 816.3 GB in use; 816.3 GB of it is not in this partial scan.'

criteria.criterion: 5 Show no coverage panel: the scan counted more on disk than the volume reports (unseen < 0)
criteria.how: Unit level only. CoveragePanelText.Build returns null when unseen < 0 (CoveragePanelText.cs:81), and AddVolumeInUse then hides the panel. CoveragePanelTextTests.AScanThatCountedMoreThanTheVolumeReportsHasNoPanel passed. No rig can make an over-count.

criteria.criterion: 6 Name each unreadable folder, with no size: two folders this account may not list
criteria.how: Case D: 2 'unreadable' folders with null size, equal to core.unreadable. The remainder says 'It includes 2 folders this scan could not read.' The screen lines carry each row's path, capped at 20 shallowest first, with 'and N more'.

criteria.criterion: 7 Name the container layer store as left out, and say the remainder includes it (precaution on)
criteria.how: Case E, SUBST over this PC's real Containers folder: one 'not-scanned' entry with null size, includesStore True. The remainder: 'It includes the Windows container layer store, which this scan left out unopened.'

criteria.criterion: 8 Word the remainder without the store when none was left out
criteria.how: Case A: includesStore False, and no container word in the remainder. The precaution-off position is covered only by unit tests (facts with no NotScanned rows); a real run would be the kernel leak.

criteria.criterion: 9 Size the volume's $MFT as the one measured part (SUBST letter over a folder on NTFS C:)
criteria.how: Case A: the measured $MFT is 10,540,285,952, equal to FileInfo of C:\$MFT. VolumeUsageTests.TheMftFigureOfASubstLetterIsTheVolumeUnderIt (decoy $MFT) passed.

criteria.criterion: 10 Leave the remainder as the whole unseen space when there is no usable $MFT figure
criteria.how: The guard at CoveragePanelText.cs:85. CoveragePanelTextTests.MeasuredAndRemainderAddUpToTheUnseenSpace passed for null, 0, negative and above-unseen figures. The VolumeUsageTests throwing and substituted-reader cases passed. There is no non-NTFS volume here.

criteria.criterion: 11 Report files whose own size could not be read, apart from the unseen space
criteria.how: Cases F and G: sizeNotRead {2, 131072} and {1, 65536}, with unseen unchanged. Clean tree (case A): sizeNotRead null. SizeNotReadTests passed.

criteria.criterion: 12 Write a count of one in the singular, and still read it in the hook
criteria.how: Case G: singular note and panel text. The real Z:\ live counters read '1 folder unreadable'. CountersReadingTests (FoldersIn reads 1) passed. Code: ShowProgress uses FigureText.Counters, and the notes use ProbeFailuresNote and VanishedNote.

criteria.criterion: 13 Give a mapped network drive no coverage line and no panel, while a local drive keeps its line word for word
criteria.how: Real SMB redirector: a SUBST over a Z:\ subfolder finished with no volume line, coverage null and the panel hidden. The mapped Z:\ itself, stopped at 15 folders, showed no partial volume line. Case A shows the local line word for word. No DFS letter exists here.

criteria.criterion: 14 Word a folder left out on purpose from one source, keyed on its reason
criteria.how: The store literals moved into UnreadableRows (named ContainerLayerStore arms plus a neutral fallback), and FolderTreeNode and TopLevelRowText call them. The Fitness rule 'in the App, only UnreadableRows words the container layer store' holds. The written-once fire/quiet rows held. UnreadableStoreWordsTests passed.

criteria.criterion: PS-028: nothing reads into the store or tries to size it
criteria.how: Case E: core.opensUnderExcludedStore 0 and the folder size is null. The store tests passed in the suite.

criteria.criterion: SC-047: the UnreadableTab and UnreadableExpander contract comments match what the tab holds
criteria.how: The diff updates the MainWindow.xaml UnreadableTab comment (it shows the left-out store too, and core 'unreadable' is the count) and the WindowReport remark (UnreadableExpander widened since SL-095).

criteria.criterion: PS-028: the panel's figures go into the report JSON as additive schema-1 fields
criteria.how: The saved report is schema 1 with the new top-level 'coverage', window 'CoveragePanel' and OutcomeTexts 'verticalOffset'. UnreadableExpander and the other existing keys are still present.

obligations.evidence:
Measured independently: the $MFT comes from Kernel32.TryGetMftValidData (GetFileAttributesExW of <volume>\$MFT, NTFS-gated), and the total from GetDiskFreeSpaceExW (VolumeSpace.ReadUsed). In case A it equals .NET FileInfo of C:\$MFT, 10,540,285,952.

Never exceeds the gap: CoveragePanelText.cs:85 adds it only when it is above 0 and no more than unseen. Otherwise the remainder is the whole unseen space, which CoveragePanelTextTests covers.

measured + remainder = unseen in cases A, D, E, F and G. Whether the real C:\ unseen is at least the $MFT (spike clause b) is still not reached and needs a whole-C:\ scan; the guard makes either outcome honest.

not_reached: The panel on the real whole C:\, scanned non-elevated with this build (spike c-drive-ending-can-carry-panel clauses a/b/c: the finished-arm line, coverage.unseen >= measured[0].bytes, and coverage.folders length against the 20-row cap). It needs the person's allow for a whole-drive scan.
A finished scan of the mapped Z:\ itself. Measured instead: a finished SUBST over one Z:\ subfolder (no line, no panel) and Z:\ stopped at 15 folders (no partial line).
DFS letters and non-NTFS volumes: none on this PC. They are covered only by unit tests.
An over-count (unseen < 0) on a real volume: no rig makes one. It is covered by a unit test only.
The precaution-off position on the real container layer store: not run, because it is the kernel leak.
The person's network pass (N-001 to N-004 plus StalledShareTests), stale since this slice touched MainWindow, Scanning and the hook. It changes SMB mappings, so it is person-run.

What a person sees at the finished ending: the panel starts 113 px into an outcome-texts region showing 76 px, so it is a scroll away. No picture of the ending with the panel exists; the engine's only screen shows the drive picker.
The default suite with the Z:\ server down: EveryMappedNetworkDriveOnThisPcIsRemoteAndGetsNoFigure (waived O-021, note N-005) was only seen passing while Z:\ was reachable.

problems.what: It shows the start screen ('Pick a drive or folder to scan' with the C:, D: and Z: buttons), not the whole-drive ending with its coverage panel that it is labelled as. The panel itself was never pictured, so nobody has looked at whether it can be found and read.

problems.where: the strip under the drive buttons
problems.what: An empty grey horizontal scrollbar with '<' and '>' arrows sits under the three drive buttons with nothing to scroll. It looks orphaned, and its arrows are probably the two nameless buttons the engine found.
Small light-grey text on white. It can be read, so the engine's 1.00:1 measurement looks wrong, but it is the faintest text on the screen.
